title: SvgFeMergeNode
responsibility: Renders the native feMergeNode element without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: SvgFeMergeNode.attributes
inputs.description: Native feMergeNode attributes and event handlers. The native atom call preserves Svelte bindings, actions and scoped styles.

inputs.name: SvgFeMergeNode.children
inputs.description: Optional content within the native feMergeNode element; native HTML content rules still apply.

outputs.name: SvgFeMergeNode
outputs.description: The actual native feMergeNode element, with forwarded attributes and content and no additional wrapper.
